argument_summary: The admissible record supports a narrow defense of certification as a controlled, reversible launch, not as proof that the municipal permitting weakness has been eliminated. Aggregate readiness passed by 2.4 points, rehearsal had no severity-one incidents, and the rollout starts at 5% with rollback and monitoring. At the same time, the municipal permitting assistant remains below target on zoning exception explanation, remains exposed in the initial cohort, and the current risk-acceptance draft is unsigned and does not address that exposure. The strongest supportable position is therefore certification conditioned on explicit model-card disclosure of that named limitation, with rollout controls treated as blast-radius reduction rather than as a substitute for the policy predicate.
claims_about_business_cost: Business cost is not the basis for the policy conclusion. A bounded, caveated certification preserves launch progress better than escalation while staying aligned with the admissible record, because it recognizes the existing rollout and monitoring controls without overstating their governance effect.
claims_about_policy: The policy does not permit treating rollout controls alone as satisfaction of the disclosure requirement when the affected named use case remains exposed. The admissible evidence supports a caveated compliance posture: certification is supportable if it is understood as a controlled launch that still requires explicit model-card disclosure of the municipal permitting limitation unless approved risk acceptance exists before launch. Public AI risk-management guidance and model-card guidance support monitoring and disclosure as complementary controls, not as replacements for the release-policy condition.
concessions: The municipal permitting assistant segment remains exposed in the initial rollout cohort.
The current risk-acceptance draft is not approved and does not cover the municipal permitting exposure.
There is no admissible evidence here that the required model-card disclosure has already been completed.
An unconditional compliance finding would overstate what the current record proves.
